method: Product-area and product-specific Fortinet Community/KB/TAC searches were run for all twelve mandatory targets. Recent means published or materially updated in the rolling 30-day window; older useful cases are explicitly labeled historical and are not represented as recent.

recent_findings.title: Websites not loading with Deep Inspection - 400 Bad Request
recent_findings.relevance: Directly supports the proxy-mode strict-web-check and ALPN lesson. Staff workaround on Oct 31: disable strict-web-check; if HTTP/2 sites still fail, set supported-alpn http1-1; flow mode unaffected in the reported case.

recent_findings.title: Custom FortiManager admin can't push switch config
recent_findings.relevance: Recent role/authorization troubleshooting scenario. Thread also exposed dmworker crashes and a RADIUS/TACACS clarification; no confirmed single root cause, so it is used as a diagnostic boundary, not proof that a new profile permission caused the failure.

recent_findings.title: Devices show down and Last Log time stale for 10-15 minutes after reboot
recent_findings.relevance: Useful but outside the 30-day window. Kept as historical diagnostic context for distinguishing GUI freshness lag from missing FAC event ingestion.

targets.disposition: No directly matched recent FortiSwitch Community technical tip was verified for the selected DNS-cache unit-change mechanism. The primary lesson is documentation-driven; no unrelated post was promoted as a scenario.

recent_findings.title: FortiAP 231K remaining offline when managed by a FortiGate
recent_findings.relevance: The page was materially updated Nov 18 and includes a current trace showing SULKING/DTLS_SETUP and certificate error 19 due to missing self-signed CA certificates. Used for the control-channel DTLS trust scenario.

historical_findings.title: Create and use a keytab file to join FortiNAC in the domain
historical_findings.relevance: Historical supporting context only; clarifies keytab/domain-join behavior, not a recent Kerberos login incident.

targets.disposition: No directly matched recent FortiNAC (legacy CA/Manager) Kerberos scenario was verified.

recent_findings.title: LDAP directory Validate Credentials fails when the domain controller requires LDAP signing
recent_findings.relevance: Very recent and directly used. TCP/389 simple bind receives result code 8 / Strong(er) authentication required when AD requires signing; LDAPS or STARTTLS is the secure remediation.

recent_findings.title: Upgrading FortiNAC-F CAs in an N+1 Failover Group when primaries are missing from Manager Server List
recent_findings.relevance: Recent secondary discovery finding; retained for future uniqueness-aware lesson selection and not promoted to today's primary lesson.

recent_findings.title: HTTP 500 error during OAuth authorization after upgrading to FortiAuthenticator 6.6.10
recent_findings.relevance: Directly used. Non-imported remote LDAP user triggers RemoteLdapSessionUser.fac_groups AttributeError at /api/v1/oauth/authorize/; fixed in 6.6.12 and 8.0.5.

historical_findings.title: Connection error when using FortiPAM native launchers
historical_findings.relevance: Historical diagnostic boundary: native launcher TLS trust-store failure is separate from process matching.
